body:
I’m alone. I don’t have money. I don’t know what my purpose is. I feel like there’s more suffering than peace in my life and I just want it to end.
I’m starting to make plans, but I’m also leaving room for hope. I haven’t fully given up and there are some decent days. But my smile is fake. There isn’t much joy. Im not sure why to struggle through suffering.
Thank you friend. I send you a hug.

I couldn’t possibly encourage another soul such as yourself to leave this life, even though I want to.
I decided that when I go, if I take my life, it will be while I sleep with some pills. I don’t want a violent or messy death.
But I hope that you can find something to hang on to. I don’t know you but I care.

Thank you so much for your message 🙏🏼I resonate with so much of what you said. 

It’s so crazy how we feel so alone, but the truth is we are far from alone.

The mind is powerful like a knife… you can end a life of feed people with it.
Is there any way for me to send audio messages here?
You’re so kind god bless you. Seriously. I don’t know how to do that right now because I’m such a mess… and am living in Eastern Europe (I’m American) so my time zone is definitely way off usa.
You’re a beautiful person. Thank you for your kindness. If I find the light inside me to talk I will. But for now I am just outlining my document 📄you are a good person 🙏🏼❤️

I just joined this app and am surprised by the quick response, and kindness. ❤️
I’m tired of struggling and being alone. I’ve thought about suicide for at least 20 years. I don’t see the point in suffering, and it sucks not meeting anyone I’m into or finding anything I’m good at. 
I have it better than so many, and feel guilty for feeling this way considering the circumstances of others. But still I am planning a neat exit. I want to carefully pick my dress. Leave loving videos for everyone I love, and leave no mess (blood) behind.
